result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one clear defect: an unresolved localization key is displayed as a section title instead of translated text.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated string (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation entry for 'home_feed.popular_title' in the locale files and ensure a fallback string is shown when a key is unresolved.
